$comment: Framework-agnostic TypeScript base for every workspace in this monorepo. Extend this directly for non-React packages; extend nextjs.json for Next.js apps.
$comment-types: `types` is set explicitly because TypeScript 7 no longer auto-includes @types packages from the monorepo root's node_modules/@types. Without it, importing from 'bun:test' fails with TS2307 even though @types/bun is installed. bun-types itself references the Node types, so process.env and other Node globals still resolve. Remember that `types` is replaced rather than merged when a config extends this one.
